evidence.text:
Sol produced a static local-first browser workbench named *The Hand Remains*.
Its material includes six gesture types, threaded relations, rehearsal against
declared laws, checksum-linked receipts, browser-local persistence, portable
JSON handoff, a visual constellation, a continuation contract, the inherited
poem, and a living edge. Its own unresolved result states that browser
interactions were not executed because the sealed environment exposed neither
a browser nor a JavaScript runtime suitable for that interaction test.

A separate model-free replay verified the exact closure. Subsequent static
inspection verified JavaScript syntax, manifest parsing, the absence of obvious
dynamic HTML injection and network primitives, and the presence of local
persistence, receipt-chain verification, import/export, and rehearsal logic.
These checks do not establish browser behavior, semantic usefulness,
architectural correctness, self-maintenance, or general emergence.

evidence.text:
## Evidence and limits

The isolated test suite passed 37 assertions. It checks persistence, refusal,
competing proposals, replay, interrupted writes, lock recovery, and bounded
continuation through the goal. It does not establish power-loss durability,
cryptographic authenticity, or distributed concurrency safety.

✓ genesis is connected, lawful, and receipted
✓ evolution is deterministic from the same material
✓ a rehearsal cannot mutate the living world
✓ a rehearsed touch commits and extends the chain
✓ a boundary refuses an unsafe shape and remembers why
✓ stale and altered rehearsals cannot cross into reality
✓ elapsed time is embodied exactly once

browser_observations.gestureReading: The touch can be carried. Kinship rises most clearly over the rehearsal, by 2%.
browser_observations.refusalReading: The rehearsal reaches a load-bearing boundary. The world can preserve the intention only if its shape changes.
browser_observations.probeAnswer: Borrowed Light carries the most strain. Its vitality is 49%. Touch it if you wish, but rehearse the cost to its neighbors first.
